connector.name: MCP Server by 1lystore
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for 1ly.store - buy/sell APIs and launch tokens on Bags.fm with USDC & $1LY.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 1lystore account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ONELY_WALLET_SOLANA_KEY
env.description: Path to Solana keypair JSON file (e.g. /home/user/.1ly/wallets/solana.json) or inline JSON byte array. Required for paid API calls and token tools (launch, trade, claim). Note: Claude Desktop does not expand ~, use absolute paths.

env.name: ONELY_WALLET_EVM_KEY
env.description: Path to EVM private key file or 0x-prefixed hex string. Required for payments on Base network.

env.name: ONELY_API_KEY
env.description: 1ly.store seller API key. Auto-saved locally after running the 1ly_create_store tool — you do not need to set this manually. Required for seller tools: manage links, stats, withdrawals, keys, and profile.

env.name: ONELY_WALLET_PROVIDER
env.description: Wallet provider to use. 'raw' (default) uses local key files via ONELY_WALLET_SOLANA_KEY or ONELY_WALLET_EVM_KEY. 'coinbase' uses Coinbase Agentic Wallet (Base network only, requires the wallet app running locally).

env.name: ONELY_NETWORK
env.description: Preferred blockchain network for payments. 'solana' (default) or 'base'. Determines which wallet is used when an API supports both networks.

env.name: ONELY_SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Solana RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com. Use a private RPC (e.g. Helius, Quicknode) for better reliability and rate limits.

env.name: ONELY_BUDGET_PER_CALL
env.description: Maximum USD amount allowed per single paid API call. Defaults to 1.00. The server will refuse any call priced above this limit.

env.name: ONELY_BUDGET_DAILY
env.description: Maximum total USD spending per calendar day (UTC). Defaults to 50.00. Resets at UTC midnight. The server will refuse calls that would exceed this limit.

env.name: ONELY_BUDGET_STATE_FILE
env.description: Path to the local JSON file used to track daily spending. Defaults to ~/.1ly-mcp-budget.json. Created automatically with owner-only permissions (0600).

env.name: ONELY_SOLANA_DRY_RUN
env.description: Set to '1' to simulate Solana transactions without broadcasting to the blockchain. Returns a fake signature. Use for testing only — no real payments will be made.

env.name: ONELY_API_BASE
env.description: Override the 1ly.store API base URL. Defaults to https://1ly.store. Only http://localhost:PORT is accepted as an alternative (for local development). Do not change in production.
